description: The public replies under one post, each with its author (username, name, avatar), text, time and engagement (likes, replies, reposts, views). X posts only for now (x.com / twitter.com status links). Use it to see how people reacted to a launch or announcement, find people worth answering, check sentiment, or pick replies to engage with. Creates nothing and posts nothing. Cost: 1 credit per page of up to 100 replies actually read (an empty page still counts), so the default limit of 100 costs at most 1 credit and the maximum of 500 at most 5 — tell the user the worst case before a call above 100. More replies? Call again with cursor = next_cursor (valid ~15 minutes).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to read the next page(s).

limit.description: How many replies to read (default 100). Billed 1 credit per started 100.

url.description: Link to the post, e.g. https://x.com/user/status/1234567890

name: get_post_replies
title: Read the replies under a post
